I made the trip up to Rothamsted Resarch to attend the annual meeting of TAAI.
The two-day conference was chock-full of interesting talks and good conversation.

Participants came from various institutions including [Biovision - Foundation for Ecological Development](https://www.biovision.ch/en/), [ECHO International](https://echonet.org/), and [Straw Innovations](https://strawinnovations.com/).

For me, highlight talks were given by [Ken Giller](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=yct61VwAAAAJ&hl=en), [Alejandro Ortega-Boltrán](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=EZTwY34AAAAJ&hl=en), and [Mélanie Surchat](https://www.biovision.ch/en/project/push-pull-diversity-through-participatory-research/).

We were even able to have a delicious curry dinner at the beautiful [Rothamsted Manor](https://rothamstedmanor.com/) and get a tour of some of the facilities including the meticulously looked-after soil sample collection from the longest agricultural experiment in the world.

My collaborators at [Universidad del Valle de Guatemala](https://www.uvg.edu.gt/) submitted a poster and won a prize!
Congratulations to them!
